messages:
carly: Morning team — kicking off SparrowGate onboarding. Goal: first integration in 30 days. Need quick confirmation of owners, success criteria, and any immediate legal/procurement risks. Who's in for owner roles?

devin: I can lead the technical integration. Need API keys and sample dataset from the customer. @carly can you confirm dataset access level?

marta: I'll run enablement and the post-launch feedback survey. Propose: 2 sessions (eng + PMs) week 2 and a 20-min power-user session week 4.

li: Product note 1: define success as: 1) parity on 10 core flows, 2) p95 latency <600ms under validation load, 3) zero critical defects at launch. If they want custom scoring, expect +1 week.

kevin: Procurement flagged that the trial PO may be delayed until legal signs the DPA. That could push timelines — mitigation: parallel sandbox validation and staged trial.

carly: Thanks. Quick asks: devin please add sample traffic shape by EOD; marta draft session invites; kevin confirm PO ETA with AE.

onboard-bot: ACTIONS CREATED:
- devin -> sample traffic example & infra checklist (due 2d)
- marta -> training invites & feedback survey draft (due 4d)
- kevin -> confirm PO / DPA ETA with AE (due 1d)

devin: Traffic shape: 90% <100 tokens, spikes to ~300 tokens during batch imports. Example curl for basic smoke test: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -d '{"model":"gptx-small","input":"test"}' https://api.redwood/v1/generate

marta: Draft invites sent for Tue 11am PT. Survey template linked in Polaris templates (internal).

kevin: AE says legal review targeted this week but could slip. Marking renewal risk if PO >14 days late.

carly: Recap: 30-day target, owners: devin (tech), marta (enablement), kevin (procurement), carly (CS). Top risks: DPA/PO delay, dataset availability. We'll run sandbox validation while legal completes DPA.

devin: :thumbsup: I'll post infra notes in the event.

onboard-bot: REMINDER: devin action due in 2 days.

carly: Thanks team, I'll update the customer and AE after these actions. Drop any blockers here."
